source.note: Upstream marks the instrumentation schema URL as TODO at this commit; no schema_url is fabricated. Only the exact registry and four content schemas below are pinned. spans.yaml is included to derive span-class requirement expressions (CLIENT vs INTERNAL invoke_agent provider requirement); manifest.yaml was retrieved and reviewed but not pinned (no derived fields).

derive.names: Every emitted gen_ai.* production literal must be provable from registry.yaml attributes (name-level derivation).
derive.types: Scalar/array types (string, int, any/template) are asserted against registry.yaml type fields for emitted attributes.
derive.enums: gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.provider.name, gen_ai.output.type, and schema FinishReason members are asserted against pinned members; Daydream only emits known members.
derive.requirement: CLIENT gen_ai.invoke_agent requires gen_ai.provider.name (required) per spans.yaml; INTERNAL gen_ai.invoke_agent must not fabricate it. Emitted attribute values must satisfy pinned enum membership.
derive.schemas: Representative Daydream input/output/system/tool JSON validates against the four pinned draft-07 content schemas.
